hypothesis: Card IR can supply direct-effect instructions to the existing Outcome resolver; on the same pre-action states and observed facts its checkable direct effects are no worse than text parsing, with explicit abstention for unknown modifiers.
baseline: Unchanged manamind.outcome.forecast.forecast_action and current observation/context mapping; no assumed-default context in real-data metrics
candidate: Experimental report-local adapter, no src/outcome modification. IR controls effect kind, amount, target, keyword and sequence; reuse Outcome _Run/World primitives and reaction guards. Refuse unrepresentable IR and contexts instead of rebuilding ManaEngine positions.
declarations: Immutable reports/card_ir_execution_pilot_1/declarations; strict v0.2 gate plus bounded translation, not semantic gold

stage_a.baseline: Current _check_numbers is asymmetric for unmarked literals and mixes their roles within an ability
stage_a.fix_scope: v0.2 strict only: role-specific signed stat pairs and discard counts in unambiguous text templates; preserve implicit defaults, expressions and metadata values; no blanket number-occurrence requirement
stage_a.freeze: Save original measurement and commit protocol before fix. Commit validator fix before any candidate real-outcome experiment. Preserve historical results; record changed verdicts separately.

data.excluded: fresh_holdout and every match absent from the explicit allow parts; filter exact/prefix membership before opening any match file; reject prefix collisions
data.observed_context: Re-extract existing ObservedFacts mechanism only from eligible per-match raw files where safely addressable; never open aggregate facts/corpora containing protected matches. Join by exact decision/state hash; otherwise all-unknown context.
data.bounds: Four cards only, all permitted available plays in the fixed current input set; no sampling to improve accuracy, no additional imports/downloads or synthetic events in real totals
data.privacy: Reports contain aggregates and public pilot card IDs only; no player names, raw match/decision IDs, hidden opponent hand or deck order. Private caches, if needed, in new ignored data/processed_real paths.

causality: Freeze permitted input hashes before forecast run. Forecast inputs contain only current state/action and facts extracted at the decision. Compute both forecasts before accessing next-state/effect evidence for scoring. Never infer a modifier from its observed action outcome.

comparison.unit: A SELF logged PLAY_CARD/SPELL of one of the four cards. Other-side or unmappable evidence observations are inventory, not scored SELF actions.
comparison.eligibility: Known before state, exact action identity; for verify score adjacent consecutive labeled decisions in same SELF turn. Evidence packets may supplement only after prediction with exact target/action linkage; ambiguous or absent after-witness excluded with reason.
comparison.primary: Observable direct-effect claims: target, damage/heal/buff kind and exact amount where available. Explicit zero/no-op verification reported separately. Resources and collateral reactions separate from direct-effect accuracy.
comparison.scorer: Reuse outcome.verify observe/alignment/path classification, adapting a precomputed forecast without changing baseline. Packet checks, if needed, are an additional named diagnostic, not a replacement incompatible estimator.
comparison.coverage: Events with at least one checkable exact direct-effect claim divided by all admitted pre-action events; also report complete direct-effect coverage and all exclusions
comparison.accuracy: Confirmed / (confirmed + contradicted) checkable direct claims; report misses, no-claim cases, event-level conflicts and denominator. No exact success from mana/played-hand bookkeeping alone.
comparison.unknowns: Stratify Spell Damage, healing bonus/doubling/conversion, Shield, Armor, overkill, Lifesteal, secrets/other reactions using pre-action context only; no default zero/false without evidence
comparison.limits: Seen real data, paired technical diagnostic, not game strength or independent holdout generalization. A small denominator or missing observations warrants INCONCLUSIVE.

ir_dependence: Controlled copies: damage 3->5, target side, removal Lifesteal, heal->damage, sequence order. Public gate must reject or forecast must change. Also test unchecked internal compilation with a deliberately inconsistent original TextSource to prove execution reads IR rather than original rules text; this path is tests only.
stop: No new simulator, native engine changes, GameState import, v0.3/S2/Herald, LIVE integration, model changes, training labels or training. If no faithful minimal adapter/data path exists, report technical limitations without pretending successful IR forecasting. Stop after report and branch push.
